f  HUD Scroll Controls (matches orb exactly):
  [ORB]   ← Return to orb view
  [⏫]    ← Double arrows, scroll to TOP of messages
  [⚙️]    ← Gold gear, click to engage variable scroll
  [⏬]    ← Double arrows, scroll to BOTTOM of messages

  Behaviour:
  - Top/bottom buttons: Instant smooth scroll to beginning/end of messages
  - Gear button: Click to engage, move mouse up/down to scroll through messages at variable speed, sideways
   or click to disengage
  - Arrow spin: Hover the gear and the arrows spin twice
  - Same styling: 28px buttons, 32px gear, 2px gap, gold metallic gradient
